title: Define StorageError variants for SQLite and IPFS failures
description:
Define StorageError: SqlxError(sqlx::Error), MigrationFailed, EntryNotFound(LogEntryId), DuplicateEntry(LogEntryId), IpfsWriteFailed(String), IpfsPinFailed(String), IpfsNotReachable. Implement retry-hint method: is_transient(&self) -> bool (true for IpfsNotReachable and IpfsWriteFailed, false for data errors). Artifact: core/src/error.rs.

Acceptance criteria: is_transient() correctly identifies transient vs permanent failures; unit test for each variant; sqlx::Error wrapping does not expose internal details in Display
